name: secure-vibe
title_zh: AI 写完代码先过 12 类安全闸
tagline_zh: AI 生成代码常带漏洞，你不可能逐行审。它毫秒级扫完 Python 到 Dockerfile，自动修 3 轮。
tagline_en: AI code often ships with holes. This lints 12 stacks in ms, auto-fixes 3 rounds, blocks bad commits, and logs.
desc_en: Fast security lint + commit gate for AI coding agents. Before writing code, inject security rules; after generating, validate in milliseconds and auto-repair up to 3 rounds, with full JSONL audit logging. Also scans whole directories (sast) and gates git commits (precommit). Supports Python/C/C++/PHP/HTML/JS/Go/Java/Shell/Dockerfile/Kubernetes/Terraform/GitHub Actions. Use whenever the user asks t
why_zh: 不是事后扫描，而是把安全规则前置到生成阶段——AI 边写它边盯，修不动就硬拦。
why_en: Injects rules pre-generation, not just post-scan. Catches issues while AI writes, repairs up to 3x, then hard-gates—saves a full.
limit_zh: 只对 AI 生成/修改的代码生效，手写代码需主动触发 sast。自动修复仅限规则库内的模式，超出后只报错不重写。
limit_en: Auto-gate only on AI-written code; manual code needs explicit sast. Repairs only rule-covered patterns; others just fail. No .NET/Ruby/Swift.
title_en: Security lint + commit gate for AI code, 3 auto-repair.
